title: Fitness App Growth Plan
background: A fitness app has strong engagement but limited paid conversion and wants to grow recurring revenue.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Identifies growth levers across customers, products, and channels
Segments customers by needs and profitability
Assesses feasibility, investment, and expected impact
great_answer_includes: Balances acquisition, retention, and expansion opportunities
Identifies operational capabilities needed to scale
Considers competitive response and market saturation
Defines metrics to track growth quality
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear growth strategy structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
